name: smwgraphics-gunstar-heroes-black-s-base-item-room
title: Gunstar Heroes - Black's Base (Item Room)
description:
A pseudo 3d tileset used in the item room of the classic cult game Gunstar Heroes. You can expand it to make really long horizontal vertical levels. It includes the Item and Exit signs, as well.

The ledge at the middle should be used with these passable ledge blocks.

I took some liberties because the SEGA Genesis has a wider resolution.
